summary: The Phase 2 adversarial guards for the week 1 student workbook are in place and all pass on the reviewed HEAD c8aba128. The guard file dashboard/__tests__/storytime-print-student-book-adversarial.test.ts holds 30 test blocks and 55 test cases: 16 cases for the HTML escape and the QR input, 9 cases for the layout rules of the inside pages, and 30 cases for the CLI and the output path. The three gates pass on the guard commit cf2f2022: GREEN_TEST_COMMAND exit 0 with 247 of 247 tests on 6 files, PROJECT_TESTS exit 0 with 400 of 400 tests on 17 files, PROJECT_LINT exit 0 with no output. One NEW defect was found and is not in the exclude list: storytimeQrUrl accepts a path that leaves the /th/st/ route, so a printed QR address can point outside the route. The route is Red, then Green.
blocking_findings: dashboard/lib/storytime/files.ts:21 - storytimeQrUrl checks only that the path starts with '/th/st/', so a path that leaves the route is accepted. The evidence: storytimeQrUrl('/th/st/../evil') returns 'https://storytime.reading-advantage.com/th/st/../evil', and a browser normalises it to 'https://storytime.reading-advantage.com/evil'. The same holds for '/th/st/../../evil', '/th/st/2/1/../../x', '/th/st/2/1/..', '/th/st/' with no level and no week, '/th/st//2/1', '/th/st/2/1 ' and '/th/st/2/1 with a newline. The printed QR address then leaves the '/th/st/' route of spec P4 and of test-strategy line 363, so a child scans a wrong address. The week field home.songUrl is a free string (dashboard/lib/storytime/schema.ts:413), so the value can reach the print. The fix route is Red, then Green: Red writes a failing guard that storytimeQrUrl rejects a path that leaves /th/st/ and accepts only the canonical '/th/st/<level>/<week>' form with an optional part query; Green tightens the check in files.ts:20-23.
nonblocking_findings: dashboard/lib/storytime/print/student-book-cli.ts:49-55 - The numeric flags use Number(), so a hex, an exponent, or a padded form is accepted: '--weeks 0x1' gives week 1, '--weeks 1e0' gives week 1, '--weeks 1.0' gives week 1, '--version 0x10' gives version 16, and '--version 1e3' gives version 1000, so the file name reads v1000. The week check and the output containment check still hold, so no wrong file reaches the print folder. The fix route is Green: parse the numeric flags with a decimal-only rule.

dashboard/lib/storytime/print/student-book-cli.ts:97 - A missing '--out' value ends in a TypeError from path.isAbsolute: the message is 'The "path" argument must be of type string. Received undefined' instead of the argument error. The build still stops with exit code 2, so the direction is closed. The fix route is Green: check for a missing flag value before the path call.

dashboard/lib/storytime/files.ts:20-23 - The query of a QR path is not checked: '/th/st/2/1?part=song&x=1' and '/th/st/2/1?part=<script>' are accepted. The host and the path stay the same, so the address stays on the Storytime host. The Red guard of the blocking finding can also name the allowed part values.

Excluded and not new: Review A A-P2-08 to A-P2-14, Review B B-P2-05 to B-P2-07, and Review C C-P2-01 to C-P2-03. A probe of the shipped code confirmed that a link to the sibling folder 'storytime2' is rejected by the parser and by the filesystem check, that a link that stays inside is accepted, and that a print folder that is itself a link is accepted. The test gap of A-P2-13 stays open and no guard of this role touches it.
evidence: Reviewed HEAD c8aba128a684c394d1b2f2186c2d072132380915 (c8aba128); phase base 03a803c8d3a45361e403d9ab2cee1225077adc43; role base c8aba128. The guard commit is cf2f2022d2f21a7845715cfbd9b0f5957571df9d (cf2f2022) and holds only dashboard/__tests__/storytime-print-student-book-adversarial.test.ts (548 insertions, 1 file).

The guard file holds 30 test blocks and 55 test cases. Vitest reports 'storytime-print-student-book-adversarial.test.ts (55 tests)'. The split by area is 16 cases in 9 blocks for the HTML escape and the QR input, 9 cases in 9 blocks for the layout rules, and 30 cases in 12 blocks for the CLI and the output path. The 5 it.each blocks give 25 plain it blocks, which matches the 25 lines that a grep for 'it(' finds.

Area 1: a hostile text in 12 English week fields and in 2 Thai week fields creates no element, because the element count of the whole book equals the element count of the clean render, and the document holds no script element, no img element, and no event attribute. The hostile text prints as literal text. A hostile start point stays inside its attribute. The Thai text keeps one span per run. The negative control shows that a broken copy with the raw payload does create an img element and a script element, so the escape guard is not vacuous. storytimeQrUrl rejects a full URL, a protocol-relative URL, another prefix, another case, a leading space, another locale, and an empty path. Both printed codes keep the S23 host and the /th/st/2/1 route and hold a module grid. A hostile query stays text in the address attribute. The build stops when the QR path is a full URL or a protocol-relative URL.

Area 2: the answer of a check row never prints, and the control shows that the same check catches the answer when a broken page prints it. The whole book carries no answer element and no answer mark. Only the tear-out sides carry a perforation mark. Every strip mark names the book, the strip number 1 to 3, and the back side. Each of the two readers has the strips 1, 2, and 3 over three leaves. A reader side holds only the two strip marks. The two QR codes print on the home front and none on the home back. The aligner side holds no text, no student work, and no perforation mark. No attribute of any element names a color picture file.

Area 3: the parser rejects the hostile --weeks values and the hostile --version values, a flag without a value, an unknown argument, and both build modes at once. The parser rejects an --out path that is relative, a tilde path, an upper-case extension, the print folder, the print folder with a trailing separator, a dot-dot escape, and a non-PDF name. The parser accepts an --out path inside the print folder, including a dot-dot that stays inside. The output check rejects an output below a chain of two links that ends outside, an output below a relative link that points outside, an output below a relative chain, and an output that is a relative link to an outside file; each test also accepts a plain inside output, so the check is not a rule that always throws. The static reading of make-student-book-pdf.ts shows that the output check runs before the folder creation, the browser launch, and the PDF/X write, and that the checked path is the written path.

The QR probe (npx tsx, no build and no proof): '/th/st/2/1?part=song' gives the canonical address; '/th/st/../evil', '/th/st/../../evil', '/th/st/2/1/../../x', '/th/st/2/1/..', '/th/st/', '/th/st//2/1', '/th/st/2/1 ' and a path with a newline all give an address; 'https://evil.example/th/st/2/1', '//evil.example/th/st/2/1', '/th/stx/2/1', '/TH/ST/2/1', ' /th/st/2/1' and '' all throw.

The first gate call reported 'heavy-run: lock wait over 600 s' with holder PID 1442919, the advantage-mmorpg E2E suite. The report goes to the PM session. The first green run failed on one guard of this file and the first project run failed on that guard and on the R12 test of the cover track, each on the 5 s test timeout under that load. The guard was made fast by one pass over the attribute values, and every guard of the file got a 30 s timeout. The second run of each gate passes.
